You are fixing an error-handling defect in a billed-probe harness on freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. You may edit ONLY: scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/door_transport.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/test_three_c_probe.py, scripts/ringer/stage7/test_door_transport.py (new if absent), and write under bench/results/stage7-3c-errfix-dry/. NEVER edit storygame/, data/, other tests, git state or .env; no billed or network call. No uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, `.venv/bin/python`.

THE DEFECT. A billed n=12 run (bench/results/stage7-3c-pump-n12/) made 498 good Cloudflare requests, then request 499 recorded spend event {"kind":"cloudflare","status":"failed","detail":"narration","error":"HTTPError"} (see its spend.json). The harness then died and wrote run-failure.txt containing only: cannot assign to field '__traceback__'. That is a TypeError/AttributeError from the failure path itself, so the real HTTP failure (status, reason) was lost and the run ended without a clear cause. The rule for these runs: on quota, outage, malformed output or cap error the harness stops nonzero and run-failure.txt must say what happened, never retrying or replacing rows.

DO: (1) Reproduce OFFLINE with a fake provider whose _request raises urllib.error.HTTPError(url, 503, 'Service Unavailable', {}, None) on one call mid-row, through the same code path the play loop uses (counted_provider in door_transport.py, engine.turn handling around three_c_probe.py lines 585-600 and 772-815, and the NarrationProviderError / RuntimeError branches, and the final handler that writes run-failure.txt near line 1156). Find which statement assigns to __traceback__ (look for frozen dataclasses, exception objects stored in or re-raised from frozen/slotted structures, `raise ... from`, ExceptionGroup or contextlib handling) and write a failing regression test FIRST. (2) Fix the cause in the files you own. If the root cause is inside storygame/ (which you must not edit), do not edit it: make the harness catch and record the failure robustly and state the storygame finding with file and line in your final answer. (3) run-failure.txt must name the exception type, HTTP status/reason when present, the row id and attempt, and keep partial rows.json/spend.json intact; the harness still exits nonzero. (4) Keep all arms, starts, fields and tests working. Match surrounding style; ruff format then ruff check touched files.

Finish by running: .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py --n 1 --dry-run --start posta --arms custody,pump --first-command 'Follow Rebecca.' --semantic on --out bench/results/stage7-3c-errfix-dry and the checker with --mode dry.
